comments.body:
A lot of good answers in this thread. I've been living in a wg in zurich for the last three years, and every time someone moved out and we put up an ad for the room, we got something like 50 replies in a few hours. Basically we don't even look at anything that comes in after more than 24 hours, because we've got plenty of people to sort through by that time. That also means that the success rate for any single email you send out is very low.

TL;DR don't even bother applying if the ad has been up for longer than 48-72 hours, and be prepared to send out a *lot* of applications.
comments.author: swiss_lt
